# Georgios Balaouras

> Portfolio of Georgios Balaouras, a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Thessaloniki, Greece. The site covers professional experience, research publications, software projects, and Formula 1 writing. Content is available in English and Greek.

The pages below are public and contain server-rendered text and ordinary links. Use the article pages as the source for detailed claims; this file is a navigation guide. Live Formula 1, music, and other widgets may change and load data separately.

## Start here

- [English home](https://mpalaourg.dev/): Introduction, experience, selected work, and contact links.
- [About](https://mpalaourg.dev/about): Personal interests and background.
- [Projects](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects): Index of projects and workshop material.
- [Publications](https://mpalaourg.dev/publications): Index of peer-reviewed research papers and their source files.
- [Formula 1](https://mpalaourg.dev/formula): Season articles, statistics, and live race information.
- [Formula 1 world champions](https://mpalaourg.dev/formula/champions): Drivers' and constructors' champions archive.

## Research publications

- [Combining Global and Local Attention with Positional Encoding for Video Summarization](https://mpalaourg.dev/publications/ism2021/): ISM 2021 paper on supervised video summarization with global and local self-attention and positional encoding.
- [Summarizing Videos using Concentrated Attention and Considering the Uniqueness and Diversity of the Video Frames](https://mpalaourg.dev/publications/icmr2022/): ICMR 2022 paper on unsupervised video summarization with concentrated attention.
- [Explaining video summarization based on the focus of attention](https://mpalaourg.dev/publications/ism2022/): ISM 2022 paper on explanations for attention-based video summarization.

## Projects

- [From Workflows to Agents: Building LLM Systems in Practice](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/from-workflows-to-agents): TechSaloniki X workshop with slides and demo files about workflows, tools, bounded agents, and evaluation.
- [Thesis](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/thesis): Analysis of smartphone energy consumption using machine learning.
- [JPEG Image Compression](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/jpeg): Implementation of JPEG compression.
- [Bash-ic Shell](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/bashic-shell): Unix shell implementation in C.
- [Image Segmentation](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/image-segmentation): Graph-based image segmentation.
- [Optimization Algorithms](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/optimization-algorithms): Algorithms for finding function minima.
- [Pi Messenger](https://mpalaourg.dev/projects/pi-messenger): Raspberry Pi Zero communication over Wi-Fi.
